item.title: The Devil Wears Prada Release Secret Track Play The Old Shit From Flowers
item.description: The Devil Wears Prada unveil Play The Old Shit, the hidden vinyl track from Flowers, now released digitally as the band prepare for a major 2026 tour.

item.title: Polaris Announce Life’s A Beach Summer Event With Set Times Locked In
item.description: Polaris will headline and curate Life’s A Beach, a one-day summer heavy music event at St Kilda’s Riviera Beach Club with an international and local lineup.

item.title: Black Stone Cherry Unite With Tyler Connolly For ‘Don’t You (Forget About Me)’ Cover Ahead Of Celebrate EP
item.description: Black Stone Cherry have unveiled a new collaboration with Theory Of A Deadman’s Tyler Connolly, reworking Don’t You (Forget About Me) ahead of their Celebrate EP and a major European tour.

item.title: Bif Naked Channels Documentary Momentum Into New Single Snowblinded
item.description: Bif Naked has released Snowblinded from her album Champion, building on the momentum of award winning documentary screenings and a renewed connection with fans.

item.title: Jay Buchanan Releases New Single True Black From Solo Album Weapons Of Beauty
item.description: Rival Sons frontman Jay Buchanan releases True Black, a gospel infused new single from his forthcoming debut solo album Weapons Of Beauty, out February 2026.

item.title: Audrey Hobert Confirms North American Headline Tour And Major Festival Appearances
item.description: Audrey Hobert has announced her first full North American headline tour for 2026, following sold-out shows and the release of her debut album Who’s The Clown?.

item.title: Ghost Release Its A Sin As Lachryma Earns Grammy Nomination
item.description: Ghost have made their long-sought cover of Its A Sin available on streaming platforms for the first time, as Lachryma receives a Grammy nomination and the Skeletour rolls on.

item.title: My Credit Didn’t Go Through Introduces Final Album From Blues Master Mike Finnigan
item.description: A new track from the late Mike Finnigan introduces a posthumous album celebrating the legendary Hammond B3 player’s voice, songs and lifelong impact on blues and soul music.

item.title: In 2025 Not A Single Australian Song Hit The Top 20
item.description: Australian artists failed to crack the ARIA Top 20 singles in 2025 while Taylor Swift logged 10 Top 10 hits, marking a historic low point for local chart performance.

item.title: Red Hot Summer Tour Adds New Stops With Paul Kelly Headlining All-Australian Line-Up
item.description: Paul Kelly will headline the 2026 Red Hot Summer Tour, with Missy Higgins, The Cruel Sea, The Cat Empire, Kasey Chambers and Jess Hitchcock joining the all Australian line up.
